svg.title: Ikon apple-touch-icon
svg.metadata: {"authoring":"native-vector","brief":"Original Bantuin mark: a capital B formed by folded planning-document shapes and deliberate negative space. Friendly geometry, compact silhouette, legible at small sizes. Flat single color with clean paths. Derive variants from one parent mark. Centered device icon on blue-white paper; essential geometry inside a circle of 80 percent diameter."}
